global.secondary_solvent_requires_separate_pack: A DMSO-d6 sensitivity branch for F3_019/F3_020/F3_021 must use a separate condition lock, manifest, conformer ensemble, reference set and output namespace (for example F3_019__DMSO); it cannot be inserted into the primary D2O manifest.

F3_019.primary_explicit_environment: hydration_cluster; test 6, 8 and 10 explicit waters until shift convergence
F3_019.standardized_fallback_if_actual_pD_is_un: pD 7.4 with DSS referencing, clearly labelled as a database-matched assumption rather than the author's experiment
sensitivity_scenarios: deprotonation sensitivity if warranted by actual pD
F3_019.reason: D2O is preferred for stable solubility and reproducible non-exchangeable 1H/13C signals of this zwitterion. DMSO-d6 is optional only to inspect exchangeable NH/OH behavior.

F3_020.primary_explicit_environment: hydration_cluster; test 6, 8 and 10 explicit waters until shift convergence
F3_020.standardized_fallback_if_actual_pD_is_un: pD 7.4 with DSS referencing, clearly labelled as a database-matched assumption rather than the author's experiment
F3_020.reason: D2O is preferred for the common aqueous ionic state. The neutral drawing is retained only as a separately labelled speciation sensitivity case.

F3_021.primary_species: at measured acidic pD, L-argininamide dication with two solvent-separated chloride counterions
F3_021.primary_explicit_environment: hydrated cation; test 8, 10 and 12 explicit waters until shift convergence
F3_021.standardized_fallback_if_actual_pD_is_un: pD 5.5 to represent the dihydrochloride salt, explicitly labelled as an assumption
F3_021.reason: D2O is preferred for this dihydrochloride salt. It gives better solution stability, while DMSO-d6 would emphasize solvent-dependent chloride ion pairing.

F3_035.species_policy: near-neutral D2O primary species is sulfamate NH2SO3-; near pD about 1 neutral/ionized composition is mixed and must be treated as separate scenarios
F3_035.standardized_fallback_if_actual_pD_is_un: pD 7.0, sulfamate anion, charge -1, clearly labelled as an assumption

F3_043.primary_observable: 31P{1H}; ordinary_D2O_1H may be HOD/background only; no 13C
F3_043.stability_control: record time from dissolution to acquisition and compare time-zero with a delayed 31P spectrum for hydrolysis

F3_044.species_policy: near-neutral D2O primary species is monoanionic diamidophosphate [O=P(O-)(NH2)2]-; around pD about 5 mixed states require separate scenarios
F3_044.standardized_fallback_if_actual_pD_is_un: pD 7.0, monoanion, with actual Na+/NH4+/other counterion recorded or separately modelled
F3_044.stability_control: record time from dissolution to acquisition and monitor monoamidophosphate/phosphate hydrolysis by time-zero and delayed 31P spectra
